import sys, json, time, random, cProfile, pstats, io
sys.path.insert(0, 'tmp'); sys.path.insert(0, 'submission')
import ref, main as M
N = 64
cyc = [1000 + 11*i for i in range(N)]
rnd = random.Random(2)
rib = []
for L in range(3, 21):
    for s in range(N):
        if len(rib) >= 998: break
        p = [cyc[(s+j) % N] for j in range(L)]
        rib.append({'path': p, 'count': 1000000})
        rib.append({'path': p[::-1], 'count': 999999})
rib = rib[:2000]
doc = {'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':None,
       'queries':[{'id':'q%d'%i,'path':[cyc[(i+j)%N] for j in range(64)],'threshold':[1,2]} for i in range(512)]}
# recompute order
spec = M.validate(doc)
ixpset = frozenset()
agg = {}
for path, count in spec['rib']:
    p = M.normalize_path(path, ixpset)
    agg[tuple(p)] = agg.get(tuple(p),0)+count
t0=time.time(); final, rounds = M.peel(list(agg.items())); t1=time.time()
core=set()
for p in final:
    for i in range(len(p)-1): core.add(M._canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
occs_m = M.collect_occurrences(final); t2=time.time()
sys.path.insert(0,'tmp'); import ref as R
occs = R.ref_occurrences(final)
order = R.find_order(R.scope_graph(occs, core))
vi = {l:i for i,l in enumerate(order)}
factors = [M.build_factor(l, occs_m[l], vi) for l in order]; t3=time.time()
Z, marg = M.infer(factors, len(order)); t4=time.time()
print("peel %.2f occ %.2f factors %.2f infer %.2f  Z bits %d" % (t1-t0, t2-t1, t3-t2, t4-t3, Z.bit_length()))
# scoring phase
spec2 = M.validate(doc); spec2['order'] = [list(l) for l in order]
t5=time.time(); res = M.solve(spec2); t6=time.time()
print("full solve %.2f" % (t6-t5))
pr = cProfile.Profile(); pr.enable(); M.solve(spec2); pr.disable()
s = io.StringIO(); ps = pstats.Stats(pr, stream=s).sort_stats('cumulative'); ps.print_stats(12)
print(s.getvalue()[:2500])
